analysis_type: Post-hoc comparison of three internal and four external same-point bound decompositions; no refitting or new experiment

comparison_rule.available_points: 369 internal plus 309 external equals 678 descriptive available points, not a universal sample or probability estimate
comparison_rule.scope_separation: Retain two internal rooted unavailable folds separately from 70 external unavailable points; do not create a combined success rate
comparison_rule.classification: Reuse the already frozen 0.5 dominance classifications without retuning
comparison_rule.validation: Require zero source identity mismatches and zero undefined zero bounds in both inputs
comparison_rule.datasets: Preserve Hahn1, Thurber, Kirby2, Filip, MGH17, Gauss1 and Misra1a as separate distributions
comparison_rule.previous_comparison: Preserve exports/internal-external-bound-comparison.json and its six-dataset figure unchanged

prohibitions: No universal internal-versus-external ranking or combined success rate
No erasure of internal rooted folds or external unavailable points
No probability, variance-decomposition or physical-mechanism interpretation of arithmetic shares
